films.title: The Isdal Woman
films.subtitle: The Woman Who Erased Her Own Identity
films.description: RELEASED v2.2.0 (edge-tts re-voiced edition) — full cinematic rebuild at 1920x1080p24 with narration by Microsoft edge-tts neural voice (en-US-GuyNeural). In November 1970, a burned body was found in Norway's Isdalen valley. Her labels were cut off, her names were false, and fifty-five years later her identity remains unknown. 16:28 evidence-first film + 4 vertical shorts. Photo-first engine: 11 credited real photographs, Ken Burns motion, film grain, crossfades. Every claim sourced; theories labelled; nothing invented.
